summary: Frontend auth testing completed. All 6 requested features verified. Both issues from iteration_4 have been FIXED: (1) ProtectedRoute now correctly redirects admin to /dashboard/admin when accessing seller/buyer dashboards, (2) Invalid credentials error message now shows user-friendly 'Invalid email or password'.

issue_1_protectedroute_infinite_loading.description: ProtectedRoute now properly redirects admin users to /dashboard/admin when they try to access /dashboard/seller or /dashboard/buyer. No more infinite loading spinner.

issue_2_invalid_credentials_error.description: Login error messages are now user-friendly. Invalid credentials show 'Invalid email or password' instead of technical error messages.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All auth flows working correctly. Supabase auth integration is stable. Admin dashboard loads data from backend APIs. Role-based access control is properly enforced.
